subtitle: On the western shore, wisdom learns to govern

panels.shot: epic wide of Valabhi’s port city and great monastery rising beyond warehouses and ships
panels.action: Gunamati & Sthiramati stand on a terrace of the Valabhi mahavihara, robes stirred by sea breeze, looking over a bustling harbour where merchants, monks and officials mingle beneath the rising sun.

dialogue.text: In Maitraka Valabhi, Gunamati and Sthiramati shape a daring path: a Buddhist seat of learning that trains the very ministers who will rule the western sea-board.

i18n.hi: मैत्रक वालभी में गुणमती और स्थिरमती रचते हैं साहसी राह: बौद्ध विद्यापीठ जहाँ वही मंत्री तैयार होते हैं जो पश्चिमी समुद्र-तट पर राज करेंगे।

panels.shot: slow push-in from sea to city, showing trade routes feeding into the capital
panels.action: A bird’s-eye view shows ships with billowing sails docking at Valabhi’s quays, caravans entering city gates, and beyond them the tiled roofs and courtyards of the great monastery complex.

dialogue.text: Valabhi, western capital of the Maitrakas, stands where sea-routes meet overland caravans, its wealth flowing from merchants and its prestige from the monks of its mahavihara.

i18n.hi: मैत्रकों की पश्चिमी राजधानी वालभी वहाँ है जहाँ समुद्री राहें काफ़िलों से मिलती हैं; धन व्यापारियों से, मान उसके महाविहार के भिक्षुओं से।

panels.shot: wide interior of monastery complex at dusk
panels.action: In the monastery courtyard, rows of saffron-robed monks recite, while a few lay students in simple cotton robes listen, palm-leaf manuscripts and counting boards nestled beside begging bowls.

dialogue.text: Here, Buddhist doctrine is taught beside niti, varta and law; Valabhi is neither purely monastic nor merely secular, but a place where spiritual and worldly learning share the same cloisters.

i18n.hi: यहाँ बौद्ध धर्म के साथ-साथ नीति, वार्ता और कानून पढ़ाया जाता है; वालभी न पूरी तरह मठ है न सिर्फ़ लौकिक, बल्कि जगह जहाँ धारा और संसार एक ही चौखट बाँटते हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a teaching hall focused on Gunamati
panels.action: Gunamati stands before a low desk in a stone hall, calm and precise, using a stylus to point at a palm-leaf manuscript as young monks and laymen sit cross-legged in attentive semicircle.

dialogue.text: Tradition remembers Gunamati and Sthiramati among Valabhi’s teachers, masters of logic and policy, guiding students through Buddhist texts and the hard questions of rule and revenue.

i18n.hi: परंपरा वालभी के आचार्यों में गुणमती और स्थिरमती को याद रखती है—तर्क और नीति के उस्ताद, जो विद्यार्थियों को बौद्ध ग्रंथों और शासन-राजस्व की कठिन पहेलियों से गुज़ारते हैं।

panels.shot: two-shot of Gunamati and Sthiramati in discussion under a colonnade
panels.action: Under a shaded colonnade, Gunamati listens while Sthiramati, thoughtful, gestures toward the city skyline; between them lie open manuscripts, some bearing neat columns of numerals.

dialogue.speaker: Sthiramati
dialogue.text: If ministers cannot weigh profit and duty together, how will the realm endure?

i18n.hi: अगर मंत्री लाभ और कर्तव्य को साथ तौल न सकें, तो राज्य कैसे टिकेगा?

panels.shot: close-up of copper plate grant being read in a dim chamber
panels.action: By lamplight, Gunamati holds a Maitraka copper plate, its inscribed letters catching the glow, while a young scribe looks on, amazed by the formal language of grants and privileges.

dialogue.text: Copper-plate grants of the Maitrakas record lands and revenues gifted to Valabhi’s monks, revealing royal trust and a curriculum tied directly to the machinery of administration.

i18n.hi: मैत्रकों की ताम्रपत्र दानियाँ ज़मीन और आमदनी को वालभी के भिक्षुओं को दिया गया बताती हैं—राजाओं का भरोसा और पाठ्यक्रम, जो सीधे शासन की मशीनरी से जुड़ा है।

panels.shot: wide shot of classroom where legal disputes are being role-played
panels.action: In a hall lined with stone pillars, students act out a mock dispute: two argue before a seated group, while Sthiramati observes, a palm-leaf on dharma and civil law resting on his lap.

dialogue.text: Valabhi’s course in law is not abstract. Students practice judging claims, weighing testimony, learning how a grant, a contract or a village quarrel can reshape the king’s revenue.

i18n.hi: वालभी की कानून की पढ़ाई हवा में नहीं है; छात्र दावे परखते हैं, गवाही तौलते हैं, सीखते हैं कि एक दान, एक करार या गाँव का झगड़ा कैसे राजा की आय बदल देता है।

panels.shot: medium shot of merchants and monks meeting in a side chamber
panels.action: In a side chamber, a wealthy merchant with rings on his fingers speaks respectfully to Gunamati, while a monk notes figures on a wooden board and sacks of grain lie stacked nearby.

dialogue.text: Merchant guilds help fund the monastery. In return, students learn varta—economics and enterprise—studying ports, taxes and prices so they can advise rulers without crippling trade.

i18n.hi: व्यापारी संघ मठ को धन देते हैं; बदले में छात्र वार्ता—अर्थ और उद्यम—सीखते हैं, बंदरगाह, कर और भावों का अध्ययन कर ताकि वे राजाओं को सलाह दें बिना व्यापार तोड़े।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Gunamati addressing mixed audience of monks and nobles
panels.action: Gunamati stands on a raised stone platform, facing an audience of monks, young nobles and clerks; his hand rests on a manuscript listing duties of ministers and rules of appointment.

dialogue.text: Xuanzang, travelling from Tang China, hears of Valabhi as a city with many monasteries and thousands of monks, its scholars well-versed in texts and in the art of governing men.

i18n.hi: तांग चीन से चलते हुए श्वेनज़ांग वालभी के बारे में सुनता है—कई विहार और हज़ारों भिक्षु वाला नगर, जहाँ विद्वान ग्रंथों और मनुष्य-शासन की कला दोनों में सिद्ध हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot of Yijing depicted in imagination, pointing from Nalanda to Valabhi on a map
panels.action: In a dim study, an imagined Yijing sits over a map of India, his finger tracing a line from Nalanda eastward to Valabhi westward, with scrolls listing curricula piled around him.

dialogue.text: Later, Yijing compares Valabhi with Nalanda, noting that western monks match eastern ones in learning, yet Valabhi’s students are known especially for training as administrators and ministers.

i18n.hi: बाद में ईजिंग वालभी की तुलना नालंदा से करता है; कहता है, पश्चिम के भिक्षु विद्या में पूर्व के बराबर हैं, पर वालभी के छात्र ख़ास तौर पर प्रशासक और मंत्री बनकर पहचाने जाते हैं।

panels.shot: wide shot of royal court where Valabhi graduates stand behind the throne
panels.action: In the Maitraka court, a king sits beneath a canopy; behind him stand composed young men in simple yet dignified robes, hands folded, while a courtier whispers of their Valabhi training.

dialogue.text: Scharfe and the copper plates preserve a memory: Valabhi’s graduates do not vanish into cloisters. Many are recruited as royal officials and ministers, carrying monastic discipline into the court.

i18n.hi: शार्फ़े और ताम्रपत्र एक स्मृति सँजोते हैं: वालभी के स्नातक मठ की दीवारों में नहीं खो जाते; बहुतों को राजकर्मी और मंत्री बनाकर दरबार में बुलाया जाता है, मठ की अनुशासन अदालत में ले जाते हुए।

panels.shot: close-up on a young minister’s face, recalling teachings
panels.action: A young minister, brow furrowed, stands before two petitioners in the royal hall, eyes briefly closing as he recalls a lesson with Gunamati on justice, revenue and restraint.

dialogue.speaker: Young Minister
dialogue.text: Law must guard both the granary and the poor man’s bowl.

i18n.hi: कानून को अनाजघर और ग़रीब की कटोरी—दोनों की रखवाली करनी है।

panels.shot: medium shot of Sthiramati teaching a text on niti with a faint fresco of the Buddha behind
panels.action: Sthiramati sits before a painted wall showing a serene Buddha; in his hands is a manuscript on niti, its opening lines discussing alliances, envoys and the five measures of policy.

dialogue.text: In these halls, niti—the science of politics—is read beside sutras. Students learn the six measures of foreign policy, but also hear how greed and anger can undo even the cleverest plan.

i18n.hi: इन सभागृहों में सूत्रों के बगल में नीति—राजनीति का विज्ञान—पढ़ा जाता है; विद्यार्थी विदेश-नीति के छह उपाय सीखते हैं, साथ ही सुनते हैं कि लोभ और क्रोध कैसे सबसे चतुर योजना भी बिगाड़ देते हैं।

panels.shot: wide shot of debating courtyard where doctrine and policy are argued
panels.action: In the debating courtyard, one group of monks argues fine points of Buddhist doctrine, while another circles a diagram of a kingdom’s regions scratched into the dust, voices low but intense.

dialogue.text: Philosophical debate sharpens minds; policy exercises give them ground. Valabhi’s teachers insist that understanding emptiness is not enough—one must also understand fields, ports and people.

i18n.hi: दर्शन की बहस दिमाग़ों को धार देती है; नीति अभ्यास उन्हें ज़मीन देता है। वालभी के गुरु कहते हैं—केवल शून्यता समझना काफी नहीं; खेत, बंदरगाह और लोग भी समझने होंगे।

panels.shot: slow pull-back from a lamp-lit manuscript copying room
panels.action: By flickering lamps, scribes and students copy texts on governance, law, grammar and Buddhist thought, stacking fresh palm leaves carefully, as a shadowed doorway opens to the sleeping city outside.

dialogue.text: Night after night, Valabhi’s rooms hum with the quiet scratch of stylus on palm leaf, preserving a syllabus where spiritual discipline feeds directly into the daily work of governing.

i18n.hi: रात दर रात, वालभी के कक्षों में पत्तों पर लेखनी की धीमी खरोंच गूँजती है, ऐसा पाठ्यक्रम सँभालते हुए जिसमें साधना सीधा रोज़मर्रा के शासन-कार्य को पोषण देती है।

panels.shot: wide aerial showing Valabhi city and monastery under changing sky, hinting at future uncertainty
panels.action: The monastery and city lie under a sky streaked with clouds, ships still anchoring in the harbour, caravan roads stretching inland, while the mahavihara’s towers rise steady yet small against the horizon.

dialogue.text: Valabhi’s end is not clearly dated; later traditions link its decline to new powers and raids along the western coast, but the record keeps the details of its fall more shadowed than its life.

i18n.hi: वालभी का अंत साफ़ तारीख़ में नहीं बाँधा गया; बाद की कथाएँ उसके पतन को नए शक्तियों और पश्चिमी तट पर हमलों से जोड़ती हैं, पर वृत्तांत उसके गिरने को उसके जीवन से ज़्यादा धुँधला छोड़ते हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in back to the terrace with Gunamati and Sthiramati overlooking sea and city
panels.action: Returning to the terrace, Gunamati and Sthiramati stand in quiet conversation, watching a ship depart and torches flicker in the city below, manuscripts tucked under their arms.

dialogue.text: Their legacy endures as a question for every age: how should learning speak to power and trade, so that those who study in cloisters can serve honestly in the great, restless world beyond?

i18n.hi: उनकी विरासत हर युग से एक सवाल करती है: ज्ञान सत्ता और व्यापार से कैसे बोले, ताकि जो मठ की शरण में पढ़ते हैं वे बाहर की बड़ी, बेचैन दुनिया में ईमानदारी से सेवा कर सकें?

title_i18n.hi: वालभी मंत्रियों को तैयार करती है

subtitle_i18n.en: On the western shore, wisdom learns to govern
subtitle_i18n.hi: पश्चिमी तट पर, बुद्धि शासन सीखती है
